title: fix(staging): declare Weaviate array metadata as array properties
body: ## Summary Preserve primitive list types when generating a Weaviate collection schema. `stage_for_weaviate()` emits lists for languages, links, email recipients, and emphasized text, but `create_unstructured_weaviate_class()` currently declares these properties as scalar `text` or `int`. The generated schema therefore disagrees with the staged values. Unwrap `Optional` and recognize `list`/`List` annotations for supported primitive types, producing the documented `text[]`, `int[]`, `number[]`, or `date[]` property type. Existing scalar and excluded-field behavior is preserved. ## Validation - Added 22 cases; unchanged upstream produces 19 failures and 3 passes. - Native schema generation and staging cover all ten current primitive-list metadata fields, three scalar controls, and bare/optional/legacy `List` annotation forms. - New and existing Weaviate staging tests: **23 passed, 1 skipped**. The existing database integration test retains its environment-based skip; no Weaviate server upload was run. - Checked the array representation against the [official property data types reference](https://docs.weaviate.io/weaviate/config-refs/datatypes). - Lockfile-pinned Ruff 0.15.10 check/format and `git diff --check` passed. ## Release note This corrects newly generated schemas. Existing collections retain their stored property types and are not migrated by this helper. ## Checklist - [x] The PR title is a user-facing release-note entry with a conventional commit prefix. - [ ] Please apply the `bug` category label during maintainer triage. - [x] No changelog edit or version bump.
